tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu gter bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /'chi med tshe'i dpal stsol ba/ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyer med de la gus pas 'dud/ /zab cing rgya che dbyer med ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun tu 'char ba'i snang ba dang*/ /nam yang gzhig tu med pa rdo rje'i tshe/ /mtha' yas dpag par dka' ba der btud nas/ /gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i drwa ba 'chi bdag bdud/ /'joms byed thabs mkhas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las/ /dbang gi chu bos rab gang bum bzang zhig /gang 'dir legs 'dod rnams kyi dpal du gyur/ /'dir mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dze tā ri'i lugs nyams su blang ba la/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi don gtso bor gyur pa bsnyen pa'i cho ga/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ gzhan don gtso bor gyur pa 'chi bslu'i cho ga ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas ba'i hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ra mi ta/ ā yur dzñā na sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ra mi ta/ ā yur dzñā na sa pā ri wā ra badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi tye/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ de'i steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng na rin po che'i bre phul dang gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos na/ chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i mu tig gi dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ me tog gi 'phreng ba la sogs pa dpyangs pa/ de'i steng du 'da' yab dang*/ pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug 'khod pa/ sgo khang so so'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang nor bu can rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing phyi nang kun du 'od gsal ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes dang*/ smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu las grub pa rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ de'i nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang*/

de'i steng du rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur ba'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang ba la bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus dkar ba'i steng du sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥyig dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa/ dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ shin du rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po sku mdog padma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma 'bum dus cig tu shar ba ltar rab tu dmar zhing*/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis phyur bur gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lo 'bras phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis brtan por bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang stod g.yogs can/ sku la tshe spel ba'i nor bu du mas rnam par spras pa ste/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ mu tig gi se mo do la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa'o/ /spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po/

de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes sems dpa' rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / lha rnams kyis ni khrul gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /ye shes kyi gzhal med khang du gyur/ 'od zer slar 'dus rang la thim/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba la 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzla bar bya'o/ / oṃ na mo bhrūṃ ā yur dzñā na hrīḥ.a ro li ka hūṃḥ snying po'o/ / tadya thā a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzñā na hrīḥhūṃ bhrūṃ swāhā/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ra mi ta/ a yur dzñā na/ su bi ni tsitta te dzo rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te saṃ myaka saṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ pu ṇye pu ṇye mahā puṇye a pa ra mi ta puṇye a pa ra mi ta puṇye/

dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsitte/ oṃ sarba saṃ ka ri pa ri shuddha/ dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te/ swa bhā wa bi shuddha mahā nā ya pa ri wā re swāhā/ zhes pa ni gzungs rings te rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /de dag kyang dang po gnyis 'bru 'bum dang*/ phyi ma khri phrag tu bzlas pas bsnyen pa'o/ /thun gyi mthar byin gyis rlabs pa bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying khar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu padma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med/ snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ snying kha'i rigs lnga tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de rnams kyang 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag /'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ gong gi sngags gsum po lan re brjod do/ /bdag nyid kyi ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub da lta nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ sogs yig rgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/

/de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu ba rang la thim/ dge ba bsngo zhing thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug go/ gnyis pa ras bris la rten pa'i cho ga'i bya ba rgyas par bshad/ rdul tshon la rten pa'i cho ga'i khyad par dbye ba'o/ /dang po la dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ stegs bu bzang po la dkyil 'khor shar phyogs su zhal bstan te bkram 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ phyi rol phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma bshams/ shar du dri bzang dang khrag blug pa/ lhor nya sha dang la phug /nub tu 'o ma dang sman/ byang du shing tog dang chang blug pa rnams so/ /yi ge phal cher na/ 'di'i shar nub go rjes par yod na'ang*/ lha dang gtor ma phyogs mthun par bshams pa'i lugs su 'dug pas/ 'di kho nas 'os shing*/ gal te shar gyi lha'i gtor ma nub tu bshoms pa sogs yin na/ lho byang gnyis kyang bsgyur dgos so/ /cha gsum gtor ma phyogs gang 'os cig tu bshams shing*/ bum pa bcu'am gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams/ mig dar me tog /rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs brnyan/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs bya ste/ oṃ a mṛ ta kunṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ badzra pā dyaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ nas shapta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis rol mo byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas byin rlabs yan chad bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po re re/ de las 'od 'phros nas yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lho ru rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu padma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lho yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nas/ spyod pa'o/ /thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ nas hrīḥyig dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun kyi mgon gyur zhing*/ nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ra mi ta/ ā yur dzñā na/ sa pā ri wa ra ehya hi/ a mṛ ta lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs bzhin gnang bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra satga ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yi ni/

/ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas/ nai wi dya ེ'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros nas yar lud pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ de nas gong du bshad pa'i sngags gsum po ci nus su bzlas la/ mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ gong ltar mchod pa byin rlabs bya ba las/ rol mo byin dbab mi dgos so/ /de nas phyag rgya spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ / mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye te/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ri mi ta/ ā yur dzñā na sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te mthar rol mo la/

sil snyan zhes pa dang*/ shapta 'i bar ro/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul nas/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba nas/ badzra wast+ra ye āḥhūṃ/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga rnams spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ / lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga la aṣta aṃ ka pu aṃ ka pu dzi te āḥhūṃ/ tshig gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba la/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ maṅga laṃ aṣta dra byaḥpu dzi te= bstod pa ni/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun/ /ma lus par ni sel mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung zhing*/ /nyes pa'i dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje lus can rdo rje can/ /rdo rje tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /bsam pa'i don kun skad cig gis/ /rang 'dod bzhin du tshim mdzad pa/ /mchog gi bdag po chen po ste/ /rin chen tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis/ /kun nas gos par mi 'gyur zhing*/ / thugs rjes chags tshul ston mdzad pa'i/ /padma tshe dpag= 'dod pa'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /bsam kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing*/ /las kyi tshe dpag= nyes pa kun las khyod grol nas/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste/ /kun gzigs tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus spangs/ /ston pa sredamed bu yi stobs/ /yon tan tshe dpag=

me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa/ /ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin zhing*/ /rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs/ /ye shes tshe dpag= rnam par rtog las khyod grol nas/ /mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba nyid/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung*/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa dang*/ spro na/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnam nges pa'i/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med padma ra ga'i mdangs ldan zhing*/ /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad bzang*/ /brgyad cus legs spras bdud rtsi'i bum bzang mchog /mnyam bzhag phyag gis bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg mchog ston pa yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /seng ge'i sgra yis bdud dang gshin rje'i dpal/ /kun tu 'joms byed gdul bya'i tshogs skyong ba/ /tshe dpag med kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par mi rtog mkhyen pas shes bya khyab//byams dang thugs rjes 'gro kun rjes 'dzin zhing*/ /dbyings dang ye shes kun du ro gcig pa/ /ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab yangs pa/ /mi 'gyur 'gag med tshe yi lhun pos brgyan/ /yon tan sna tshogs rin chen gter 'dzin pa/ /dpag yas 'byung pos bsten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /ma rig mun sel tshe dang ye shes kyi/ /snang ba bskyed par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang*/ /drang srong gis sbyar rigs sngags mthu yis kyang*/ /'di ltar 'gro ba'i dpal 'byor rgyas byed cing*/ /skye rgu'i 'dod don gang lags sgrub bgyid na//

skyabs mchog khyod ni mgon du legs bgyis nas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rtag tu brjod bgyid cing*/ /rtse gcig yid kyi gus pas gsol btab na/ /'dir ltar skal bzang 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /de ltar dgongs nas ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi bdag la dgongs nas kyang*/ /las dang glo bur rkyen las byung ba yi/ /gshin rje'i gnod pa ma lus bzlog tu gsol//nad gdon bar chad tshogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /bum pa bzang sogs dngos grub kun thob nas/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'grub ste/ /tshe dpag med mgon go 'phang thob par mdzod/ / ces bstod cing gsol ba btab/ de nas bum bskyed ni/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du bhruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyanapa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba rnams las/ bum pa dgu po rnams kyi nang du pad zla la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig re re yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi bum par rnam par snang mdzad tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ shar gyi bum par rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lho'i bum par rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub kyi bum pa padma tshe dpag med/ byang gi bum par las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar gyi bum par kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lho'i bum par yon tan tshe dpag med/ /lho nub kyi bum par ye shes tshe dpag med/ /nub byang gi bum par mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ /thams cad kyang nas spyod pa'o/ / gal te bum pa gnyis las med na/ yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ spyod pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi skabs bzhin/

las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing*/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ nas/ badzra sa mā dza 'i bar gong bzhin/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥslar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar yang mdun bskyed bzhin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus rtsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes las bum nang gi lha la yang bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzugs thag la brten nas song / bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag nas bzung la sngags gsum po ci rigs par bzla/ las bum la dmig nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'ang nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ /mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blug go / de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma gzhung nas ma bshad kyang*/ phyis kyi rnams lag len la mdzad pa ltar na/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/

oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gzungs ring kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyeḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa e maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel la stabs/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma yang gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e hye hi/ tsa tur mahā rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ oṃ dhri ta raṣta ya/ oṃ bi ru ḍha ka ya/ oṃ bi ru bhakṣa ya/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ya sa pā ri wā ra bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ nas/ ga ga na khaṃ grihṇa daṃ bāṃ li ta swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ spro na re re'i mtshan sngags la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis phul na shin tu legs so// oṃ tsa tu mahā rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ mar gad mdog can pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ / 'phags skyes po la= /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la= ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i/

/rnam thos sras la= dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing*/ /sgrub la brtson pas byang chub thugs su chud/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la / nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ de'i rjes su sgos kyi chos skyong gi gtor ma yod na'ang rang rang gi cho gas bsngo/ 'di la nag po chen po sogs la rgyal chen gyi cho ga'i rigs 'gros sbyong ba'i lag len 'dug na'ang snying pos dben pas sgos kyi chos skyong gi gtor chog rnams yang na mi byed/ byed na rang gzhung gi 'bul dgos kyis/ blo bzo mi bya'o/ /de'i rjes su phyogs skyong dang*/ 'byung po spyi dang*/ bgegs kyi gtor ma te/ gtor ma cha gsum du grags pa'ang nges par gtong dgos la/ de'i cho ga ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i dbang gi cho ga rnams slob dpon nyid kyis bdag 'jug tu blangs/ slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug pas don du bzlas pa ci rigs par bya'o/ / gsum pa la dbang bskur ba ni slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad ci rig par bya/ spro na chos 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus dang che ba'ang brjod nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇḍal 'bul bar bskul/ de rnams kyis kyang manḍal 'bul/ de nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum nges bzlos kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab/ oṃ tsakṣuḥbandha wā rā ā ma na ya hūṃ/ gis gdong bcing*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ gi me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ las bum gyi chus bsangs la/

a mṛ ta 'i sngags brjod/ rigs dang mthun pa brtag pa'i slad du/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes rjes zlos kyis lan btab/ slar yang mthar thug gi don gnyer brtag pa'i slad du/ de yi bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa la/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes rjes bzlos kyi lan 'debs su bcug /slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ka tsitta u pa ta ya mi/ zhes rjes bzlos bya/ rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ/ ho siddhiḥbadzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba chen po 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes pa gsang bar gdam/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo drung du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor la 'dud pa tsam byed du 'jug cing*/ hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'i rjes bzlos dang*/ yol ba bsal/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la lan gsum du phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ gnas gsum du thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ 'di'i rjes bzlos/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ oṃ na mo me hū ཾ / oṃ na mo na maḥ hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du bcug / maṇḍal 'bul bar skul la/ slob mas kyang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal 'bul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/

rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lhag par gnas pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ yon tan dang*/ nus mthu thams cad dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams mthu stobs ma lus pa dang*/ nor bu dang*/ sman dang rigs sngags dang*/ bcud len dang*/ grub pa'i rdzas rnams gtso bor gyur pa 'byung ba'i khams thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud de mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad kyi dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i ngo bo rnams 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyis sku'i rnam par bsdus/ nam mkha'i dbyings las kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar phyogs thams cad nas byon te/ slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bzhugs shing 'dres/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad byang*/ lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur/

snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badzra ā be sha yaḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes bzlas shing spos dang*/ rol mo bya/ de nas spyi bor rdo rje bsnol mar bzhag nas/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes lan gnyis kyis brtan par bya/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra ho/ zhes rjes bzlos byed bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am/ rigs kyi lha la me tog 'dor du gzhug /me tog slob dpon gyis blangs la slob ma'i mgo bor bcings te/ pra ti gṛhṇa twaṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā bā la/ zhes brjod de me tog phul ba'i lhas dngos grub stsal bar mos su bcug /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dzñā na tsakṣa hūṃ ā/ zhes brjod de gdong g.yogs bkrol/ he badzra pa shya zhes lta bar bskul te/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bshad do/ /bdag 'jug gi tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ / nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ / lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi lha rnams dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng gi phyogs su gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can mtha' bskor du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gdan de nyid kyi steng du slob ma hrīḥlas rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog padma ra ga'i nas/ thugs kar hūṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hriḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ rigs sngags 'di la dgongs pa gcig gyur sangs rgyas tshogs/ / bye ba gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed dbus su te/ /shar du bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu lho phyogs su/ / bye ba bdun cu rtsa bdun nub tu bye ba phrag /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byang du bye ba drug cu lnga/ /byang shar sogs la bye ba phrag gi grangs sgres pa/ /lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang ni bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang*/ /sum cu rtsa drug nyer lnga rnams ni sangs rgyas so/ /gzhan yang mtha' skor du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa rnams dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zha ེ sa rjes zlos kyis gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang rnam snang tshe dpag med dbyer ma mchis pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs shing bum chu 'thung du bcugal/ oṃ bai ro tsā na ā yur dzñā na siddhi sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hū ཾ / lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig / de nas rol chen dril bsil tsam dang bcas pas kyang rung ste/ pha rol du phyin pa drug gi shis pa brjod nas dbang bskur ba ni/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yis seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs nas/ /snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na/

/sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ de bzhin du sbyin pa zhes pa thams cad du/ tshul khrims zhes sbyar ba dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab ces pa'i bar du 'don pa spo/ sho lo ka re re'i mthar/ sbyin pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog / ces pa nas/ shes rab mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog / ces pa'i bar tshig rkang re re 'jug pa'i lag len snang ba bzhin byas kyang 'gal ba med par mngon la/ 'ga' zhig dkyus kyi tshig rkang mtha' ma dor nas/ de 'don pa ni bka' la dbang za bar 'gyur bas spang ngo*/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas slangs te/ sems can gzhan gyi srog bcad pas/ tshe 'dir tshe thung ba'i las sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ rnam snang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par mos pa gyis/ zhes sogs/ yang gong bzhin gsol ba btab/ rnam snang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes pa'i tshab tu/ rdo rje tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa / bai ro tsā na zhes par/ badzra de bzhin du/ lus la rdo rje'i tshe dbang*/ zhes dang*/ khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gis kun nas/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ ces 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du/ rin chen= ratna= rin chen tshe dbang= nga rgyal dang ser snas= rin chen tshe dang= de bzhin du/ padma= padma= padma'i tshe dbang= 'dod chags kyis= padma tshe dang*/ de bzhin du/ las kyi= karma= phrag dog gis= las kyi tshe dang*/ zhes pa spo/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ rigs lnga'i bum pa rnams kyis re re bzhin dbang bskur ba yin la/ gnyis su bsdus pa yin na/ de thams cad la rnam rgyal bum pa kho nas dbang bskur ba yin no/

/ de nas cod pan gyi dbang ni/ de ltar rigs lngas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ padma'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs la/ oṃ padmo bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas bar 'dir spro na bzlas lung sbyin pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ lag len mi mdzad pa shas che'o/ /de nas bum pa dgu yod na mtshams kyi bum pa bzhis/ rim pa bzhin 'khrud pa'am/ gnyis las med na/ las bum gyis lan bzhir 'khrud de/ kun gzigs tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la sogs mtshams kyi tshe dpag med bzhi po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ slob ma'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad bkrus par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ nad thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad= byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad= mtshan mo nag mo dang*/ dus kyi zhags pa dang*/ gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad= gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad= rgyal po dang the'u brang gi gnod pa thams cad= btsan dang dmu'i gnod thams cad= klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bkru'o/ /de nas byabs pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ de'i 'od zer gyis/ slob ma'i nad gdon sdig sgrib phra zhing phra ba thams cad kyang rdo khab len gyi lcags phye blangs ba bzhin du blangs te phyir dor bar mos shig / sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sogs gong gi mthar/

shintaṃ ku ru 'i dod du/ a pā na ya zhes pa bzhug go /de nas bsrung ba ni/ slob ma'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re re bzhag pas/ rdo rje de las de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ lus la rdo rje'i go bkon te/ phyin chad gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par byas pa'i mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la sngags gsum gyi mthar/ gong dang 'dra ba las shintaṃ ku ru tshab tu rakṣa rakṣa zhes pa bcug /de la gnas bdun ni/ spyi bo/ snying kha sog phrag /dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ pus mo g.yas g.yon rnams so/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs ni/ slob ma'i snying kha padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la rnam snang tshe dpag med/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lho ru rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu padma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ spyi bo'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ snying kha'i rigs lnga tshe dpag med la thim pas de rnams kyang 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bskul ba'i bar du rkyen gang gis kyang mi shigs pa'i 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ gzungs sogs gsum po'i mthar/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spang bar gyis/ /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom te/ /bu khyod tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ / zhes brjod/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs brnyan rnams snying po lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/ rim pa bzhin lag tu gtad la/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan shing mu khyud rab mnyam ldan/ /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/

/'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūrya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*/ /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ maṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen= wa sti ratna= gang yang rgyal bas mu tig mdangs ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thub la dbul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon po rin chen= mahā sta ratna= yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i// glang po rin chen= hasti ratna= tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa'i/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen= a shwa ratna= 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur bas/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ dmag dpon rin chen dam= pu ru ṣa= bkra shis rdzas brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad slob ma rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṅga la aṣta dra bya swāhā/ de nas rim pas slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rdo rje slob mas gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas/

shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig / de bzhin du/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa bsrung gis gi haṃ phyag tu phul ba zhes dang*/ gi hang gi rdzas la zhes 'don pa spo/ gi hang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zugs rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig / de bzhin du/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho/ zho'i rdzas la rten nas/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs te/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /rtsa tshong bkra shis kyi rtsa dur ba/ dur ba'i rdzas la/ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub ste/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cigalha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba= bil ba'i rdzas la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cigalha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba= dung dkar gyi rdzas la/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bus li khri= li khri'i rdzas/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus byas nas/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig

/phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar= yungs kar gyi rdzas= yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog / de dag gi mthar spro na/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs/ bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum bya'o/ / de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi yon 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs slob mar khas blangs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs gong bzhin bya/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ sogs sam bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la 'chi ba med par tshe'i dngos grub stsal ba dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas/ tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/

zhes dngos grub zhu/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum sogs brjod pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ khyed kyis sems can sogs badzra muḥ mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis kyang gang 'grub bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i cho ga de dag lhag par nges par byas nas/ cho ga'i khyad par lhag po rnams brjod par bya/ thog ma nyid du/ sa chog /lhag gnas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba rnams sbyor dgos shing*/ 'og ma so so'i skabs su'ang cung zad cung zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ de yang dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa gzhi'i/ dbus kyi char dkar gtor gnyis/ rang gi mdun du/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ rdo rje dril bu nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las grub pa'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar bhrūṃ las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rgyas pa la dga' na cha gsum gtor ma bzhin phyogs skyong gi gtor ma btang*/ bsdu na oṃ dā sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra bhyaḥ.arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā' tyaṃ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra bhyaḥ.a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ puṣpe nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhu mi pā la sa pā ri wā ra bhyaḥ

zhes pa thams cad kyi mgor sbyar nas arghaṃ pādyaṃ gis chu gnyis/ a kā ro/ lan gsum gyis/ gtor la/ puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis nyer spyod dang*/ rol mo phul/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom na/ gnyen gshin du gyur pa'i sems kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la ci bde bar stsol la/ dge ba'i sdong grogs rgya chen pos mdzod cig / ces pa'i mthar gtor ma btang*/ gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā wa naṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ a mṛ ta kunṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa bzla bzhin du/ sa gzhi la yungs dkar dang*/ thal bas gtor/ spos chus chag chag btab/ lag pa g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la reg ste gzungs sam snying po lan brgya rtsa brjod la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o/ /zhes blos bzung zhing ngag tu brjod/ oṃ bhu khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur*/ hūṃ la ཾ hūṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badzra bha wa bandha hūṃ/ phyogs thams cad yongs su bcing bar gyur/ zhes brjod do/ / gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du dri'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu/ mchod gtor dang bcas pa bshams la/ mchod pa gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sku mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ pra thi wi de wi bhyaḥ zhes thams cad la sbyar te/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gong bzhin 'bul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ / lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yi/

/ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang arghaṃ gyis mchod yon phul te/ sa'i lha mo/ slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/ tshom bu de bsal nas slar yang dri'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu dgu bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i steng du/ dri bzang gi thig le rnams padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs kyi mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du yongs su 'khod par gyur/ mchod pa rnams gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la rab tu gnyen gshin pa'i/ thugs kyis sa'i phyogs 'dir lhag par gnas pa mdzad cing*/ nang par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ spro na/ tshe dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur te/ spyi rgyud ltar snyan gsan dbab na'ang shin tu legs so/ / nang par 'degs pa'i lugs yod kyang skabs 'di nyid du byas na lag len bde ste/ oṃ badzra u tiṣtha/ zhes rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog te/ mdun bskyed kyi lha snam mkhar btegs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gsum gyis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang sa gzhi la bsrung ba bya'o/

/de nas gong du bshad pa ltar bum pa lhag gnas bya/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni gcig tu dgos pa ma yin zhing deng sang phal cher/ lag len la mi mdzad mod/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang bskur sogs 'ga' zhig la mdzad pa ltar na'ang legs pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang*/ gsol btab dang spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ rgyun bshags dang*/ sgo gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs zhing mchod pa dang/ so shing dang*/ khyor chu dang*/ ku sha dang*/ bsrung skud dang*/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang*/ rmi lam brtag pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thig skud sna lnga gcig tu sgril ba zhig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī a yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i thig skud sna lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi thig skud spyan drangs te/ dam tshig gi thig skud la thim/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes lan mang du bsngags/ thig chen brgyad gdab tshul spyi dang mthun par gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rkyang rta babs sgo tshad gcig la snam bu bzhi par bya zhing*/ rtsa thig la reg tu nye bar nang gi padma'i mu khyud kyi phyi thig bskor/ lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /mthar badzra muḥ zhes thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs te thig skud byin rlabs so/ /rdul tshon byin rlabs ni/ thig skud ces pa thams cad rdul mtshon zhes pa dang*/ mthar oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes bsngags pa las gzhan rnams de nyid dang 'dra ba ni rdul tshon gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul yang spyi dang mthun/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin 'bri zhing*/ lha mtshan ni bum pa ser po dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa bri'o/

/'di nyid kyi gzhung kho bos mthong ba phal cher na/ lha dgu nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par byas 'dug na'ang*/ bod kyi yi ge snga phyi thams cad na zla gdan kho nar yod pa'i/ zla gdan du 'os par yang mngon la/ lag len gyi rgyun la'ang zla gdan kho nar snang la/ zla gdan du bya la/ khyad par can gyi rgyu mtshan zhig yod na ma gtogs/ rgya gzhung gi yi ge ma dag par sem mo/ / mthar rgyan dgram pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren dngos de sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas zhes 'don pa spo/ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ yang thugs ka'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de nas slar yang thugs ka'i sogs dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ rjes chog gi tshe/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol spyi dang mthun no/ / ras bris sam rdul tshon gang yin kyang rung ste/ cho ga nyin zhag sbrel ma byed pa'i tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa bshegs pa nyin re bzhin byed dgos la/ rdul tshon la dngos gzhi'i nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren mi byed pa nyid dag pas/ ngag 'don ras bris kyi skabs su bshad pa nyid kho nas chog go /de bzhin du bum pa sgrub tshul yang ras bris gzhan no/ / gsum pa ni/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gang la rten kyang 'dra ste/ las bum mam las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i spos chus/ sgrub bya'i las thams cad dam/ yan lag lnga legs par bkrus te/ khrus khu phyed khams phor so mar bzhag /phyed sa nag dang*/ mchod rten rnying pa'i sa/ ro thal/ rdza thal/ tshig snag rnams dang bsres te/ gshin rje'i gzugs nag po dbyugs pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa zhig bcos la/

sla nga'i nang du kha cung zad sbub pas mgo lhor bstan te dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su bzhag /de la gdan gzhi nag po 'ding zhing*/ steng nas kyang ras nag gis cung zad bkab/ de'i mdun du kham phor 'o mas bkang ba dang*/ nya'i bdug spos kyi snod dang*/ nyer spyod lnga rnams bshams/ me tog nag po dang*/ 'bru nag po'i rigs dang*/ sha mar bu ram gser dngul sogs rin po che dang*/ tshwa sogs gshin rje'i rdzongs rnams dang*/ de rnams 'jal pa'i bre la/ oṃ asma sarba sa tsi swāhā/ zhes bris shing bzla srang dang zho cha la/ oṃ thib ta mthong ba'i rgyal po swāhā/ zhes bris shing bzlas la snga ma dang nye bar bzhag /'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag gi dkar po la mar gyi sdong bu lnga/ nag po la mar nag gi sdong bu lnga btsugs/ shar ram nub tu bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su/ ku sha'i gdan la sgrub bya'i glud gos tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram ris su bcings nas bzhag /dug sna btab pa'i chu kham phor gang 'o ma dang bsres pa yang gang 'os su bzhag cing*/ stan dkar po dang*/ me tog dkar po sogs kyang 'dzom par bya ste/ de yan chad ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dgram pa dang lhan cig bshams kyang rung*/ bum pa sgrub pa yan chad kyi bar gang la byas kyang 'dra'o/ /lho phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du tshe mdo bzhugs su gsol/ /byang phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du 'chi med rnga sgra bzhugs su gsol te/ dbang bskur thos pa re res gtsang sbra dang bcas te*/ de gnyis klog grangs ni sgrub bya'i lo grangs byed pa'i lag len kho na yod kyang bshad tshod bzhin lan brgya rtsa brgyad nyid byas na legs pa ste ma tshar gyi dogs na klog mkhan cha gsum bzhi bya'o/ / de yang slob dpon gyi rdzas de dag thams cad sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis rlabs pa'ang*/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brgya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byin gyis brlabs/

gzugs brnyan de gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa dngos su bsam/ mdo klog mkhan gnyis las lho mas gzungs mdo tshar re thon pa dang*/ me tog nag po sogs bre srang zho cha rnams kyis gzhal/ gzhi nag po'i steng du spungs te/ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la rdzongs kyi dngos po 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes ming smos nas/ bre gcig bcu brgya stong grangs med pa'i bar du 'bul gyis/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i tshe glud dang srog glud bzhes la/ gnod pa'i sems spangs nas/ phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ srang dang zho cha la'ang des 'gre/ byang mas mdo tshar re thon pa dang*/ tshon skud de la nya'i dud pas bdug/ de rnams grub tu nye ba na/ slob dpon gyi 'jig rten 'das gtor dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma dang*/ cha gsum rnams gtong*/ mdo klog zin pa na/ 'brang rgyas phyed mar gshags la/ nag po ngos de snod cig tu bcug /mar nag gi sdong bu lnga yang spar la/ khrus khu'i kham phor dang lhan cig gshin rje'i gzugs kyi mdun du bzhag la/ slob dpon yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos 'di skad ces/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sdai dpon po/ /ma mo kun gy-i tshogs rje bo/ /gson gshin kun kyi zam kha ba/ /shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /gson po bkos la 'debs pa po/ /dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can/ /'di skad nyon cig 'chi bdag nyon/ / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ / sgrub bya che ge zhes bya ba'i/

/tshe dang srog gi glud 'bul gyi/ /'dod yon rin chen sna lnga dang*/ /'bru dang mchod yon sna tshogs dang*/ /zhal zas me tog sogs mchod dang*/ /glud 'di lung la tshe srog byin/ /bzung ba thong la bcings ba khrol/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' cig /khyod kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags la/ / bza' ba bzang po 'di 'bul gyis/ /'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams/ /ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs/ zhes pa'i mthar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu brjod cing*/ gzugs brnyan/ rdzongs chas/ nyer spyod/ gtor ma/ khrus khu/ gzhi stan khebs sogs thams cad lho phyogs kyi grod zad mthar skyal lo/ /de nas glud gos kyi tshon skud bkrol la/ des sgrub bya'i yan lag lnga bcings/ slob dpon bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bden pa bdar ba'i mthar/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig sgrib nad gdon 'khon grib mi gtsang ba/ chags che nyams nga*/ lo skeg /zla skeg /zhag skeg /byad kha/ phur kha/ mi mthun par byed pa/ mtshan mo nag mo dang*/ dus kyi zhags pa'i gdon la sogs pa mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang yin pa thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la/ tshon skud sna lnga pa 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig

/oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ a mṛ ta lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i ral gris tshon skud de gcod cing*/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*/ /tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug che/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa ste/ /de dag rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis/ /byad sdems las rnams chad gyur cig /oṃ sarba bandha ka khorda tstshe da nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dum bu mang por btubs te/ kham phor so ma'i nang du/ 'o chab dang dug chu bsres pa de la tshon skud dum re dang*/ bum chu thig re sgrub bya'i lus la bskor/ rjes su blug /snying po'i mthar/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dug bcom par gyur cig /ces brjod/ mthar rdo rje gsor zhing 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug masum stai/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ / de bzhin du chos dang dge bdun la'ang sbyar/ sa 'di dug gi ma yin te/ /sa 'di dug gi pha yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yis su/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song*/ / de bzhin du chu dang me dang rlung rnams la'ang sbyar/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis= dgra bcom pa'i= phyir mo 'ong ba'i= lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i= rgyun du zhugs pa'i= bden par smra ba'i= gzi brjid kyis= de bzhin du tshangs pa'i be con gyis dug nges par bcom mo/ /dbang po'i rdo rjes= khyab 'jug gi 'khor los= me lha'i dbal gyi= chu lha'i zhags pas= lha ma yin gyi sgyu mas= klu'i rigs sngags kyis= drag po'i mdung rtse gsum pas= skems byed kyi mdung thung gi dug nges par bcom mo/

/ dug sa'i nang du song zhig /chu'i nang = me'i= rlung gi nang du song zhig / ces brjod la de dang glud gos lhan cig byang phyogs kyi grong khyer zad sar skyal lo/ gtor ma dang glud skyel ba rnams phyir bzlog dus phyir mig mi lta/ sgrub bya de la dbang bskur rgyu yin na/ skabs 'dir stan bzang po la bzhag /'brang rgyas gtad/ shis pa brjod la dbang bskur/ dbang gi bkru byabs bsrung gsum gyi skabs/ cung zad 'don pa spos pas rung*/ 'chi bslu rkyang pa byed pa'i tshe/ las bum gyis chus/ bkru ba dang*/ byab pa gnyis song ba'i mtshams su/ de lta bu'i khrus khu de chu bo'am/ mtsho'am/ lteng ka sogs su dor la/ stan dkar po bting ba'i steng du me tog dkar po bkram/ sgrub bya slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ stan rnying pa las bslangs nas/ gsar pa'i steng du 'greng bas gnas pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mdzad/ /chos ma yin ni chos kyis so/ /dge bdun gyis ni mu stegs pham/ /dbang pos lha min pham par byas/ /lha min gyis ni zla ba pham/ /nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho'o/ /me yis shing rnams pham par 'gyur/ /chu yis me yang pham par 'gyur/ /rlung gi sprin rnam rab tu pham/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden pa rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas kyang bden chos kyang bden/ /bden pas rgyal 'gyur rdzun ma lags/ /dza ye dza ye su dza ye stu/ zhes bden stobs brjod/ ku sha'i rtses bsangs gtor byas la sgrub bya 'dug du bcug go /de nas gong bzhin srung ba'ang byas te/ 'brang rgyas kyi phyed dkar po sgrub bya'i lag tu gtad la/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas/ /snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni/ /de ring bu yis bza' bar gyis/ /'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /zhal zas gtad pas nad kun las/ /grol 'gyur the tshom mi dgos so/ / snying po lan gsum bzlas la cung zad bzar bcug

/de nas me tog dkar po gtor la rol mo'i sgra dang dbyangs snyan pa dang bcas pas/ sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /ston mchod dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog / tshig rkang pa dang po gnyis 'dra/ phyi ma gnyis la/ zhi ba chags bral= chos la zhes dang*/ tshogs kyi dam pa= dge bdun zhes 'don pa spo/ 'byung po gang dag sogs dang*/ 'di na rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ / shin tu bden pa gsungs zhing rdzun min pa/ /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig/bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog / ces pas thog drangs pa'i bkra shis ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar na chos 'di gang las brgyud pa ni/ bod kyi brgyud pa rnams la mi 'dra ba sna tshogs nas brgyud pas chog mod kyi/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba brjod/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med bram ze'i rigs las byung ba'i slob dpon snying po'i zhabs te mtshan dngos snying po'i lha/ de'i sras slob dpon chen po dze tā ri/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po/ slob dpon ting 'dzin bzang po/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa ba ri lo tshā ba sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /de la don gyi slad du mtshan na smos te/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*/ mkhan chen rin po che lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' dpal bzang gsum gyis gsan/ de rnams las dngos kyi thob te 'khums so/ /༈ de ltar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad nas/ de dang 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod pa rnams brjod na/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs/

gzhal yas khang bskyed mi dgos so/ /bzlas pa'i skabs 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs ring nyid ci nus su bzla zhing*/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ādya ā mi ta bha ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te sa ཾ myaksaṃ buddha ya/ tatya thā/ oṃ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta utdha we/ a mṛ ta saṃ bha we/ a mṛ ta gardhe/ a mṛ ta siddhi/ a mṛ ta ta dze/ a mṛ ta bi grante/ a mṛ ti bi granta ga mri ni/ a mṛ ta ga ga na kirti ka re/ a mṛ ta duntu bhi swa re/ sarba artha sa dha na/ sarba karma kle sha /kṣa yaṃ ka ri swāhā/ zhes bya ba dang*/ lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa'i snying po nye snying gnyis rnams bzla zhing*/ gzhung las tshe gzungs oṃ gnyis mar grags pa'ang bzla bar bshad do/ /mdun bskyed kyi skabs/ lha lngar byed na/ gtso bo'i sku'i g.yas kyi 'dab ma la/ hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs dkar po padma dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ g.yon du hūṃ las mthu chen thob sngon po yid tsam khro ba rdo rje dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ de gnyis rgyan dang na bza' gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'o/ /mdun du hūṃ las gshin rje gshed nag po dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu hūṃ las rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dkar po 'dzin pa/ de gnyis kas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ mtshams bzhir bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba padmas kha brgyan pa rnams so/ / rgyas pa la mos na/ gshin rje gshed kyis 'og tu/ bdud mchod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang*/ rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu legs par lta ba dang*/ zhes bya ba mnan pa/ lha snam la/ lho ru 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzang po mchog /byang du yum lha mo gzi brjid can/ de gnyis sems dpa' sems ma'i cha lugs can/ nub tu btsun mo bzang skyong ma/ shar du sras zla 'od/ shar lhor rim gro ba gnyan pa dri med/ lho nub tu shes rab can gyi mchog bzang po'i tog/

nub byang du rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog bkod pa chen po ste/ de rnams rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can no/ /byang shar du nyan thos 'dus pa'i tshogs ci rigs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nang thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi 'khor tshogs du ma dang bcas pa'o/ / yab yum man chad kyi lha 'di rnams ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi skabs spyan drangs nas/ lha lnga'i dam ye bsres pa'i rjes la bskyed pas chog go/ bstod pa'i skabs spyi bstod 'dra zhing*/ sgos bstod ni/ gtso bo la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang*/ 'khor la/ bzang po spyod pas 'gro ba 'dzin mdzad cing*/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku lus gangs ri 'dra/ /thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs mchog mnga' yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bdud bgegs gdug pa tshar gtsod rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos nyid skye med don ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bgegs chen ma lus 'dul mdzad gshin rje gshed/ khro bo'i tshul 'chang stobs chen dpa' bo ste/ /dbyug tho 'bar bas dgra bo thal bar rlog /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can hūṃ gi nga ro ldan/ /dpal chen byi ru'i 'od 'bar nyon mongs sreg /bdud dpung 'joms phyir dbyug pa'i phyag mtshan can/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi sras po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sku/ /nyan thos 'dus pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos sogs kyis bstod/ de ni dze tā rīs mdzad pa yin la/ bstod pa rgyas pa la dga' na sbyar bas rung ngo*/ /'di la lhag gnas bzhi char nges par mdzad kyi 'dug cing*/ lha lhag gnas dang*/ bum pa bsgrub pa'i skabs kyang 'don pa spo dgos pa rigs 'gres shes shing*/ lha lnga kho na bya'o/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi'i skabs/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ sogs kyi dod du/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ sogs kho na sbyar/ bai ro tsa na ā yur dzñā na sogs kyi dod la/ gtso bum la/ oṃ bhrūṃ sogs dang*/ shar gyi bum pa la/ oṃ āḥkro dhe ka hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ lho'i la/ oṃ bha ra ta ka ye swāhā/ nub kyi la/ oṃ ā mṛ ta utbha wa ye swāhā/ byang gi la/ oṃ badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams la/ ā yur dzñā na siddhi sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes pa btags/ lhag ma gzhan rnams lha sngags brjes pa kho nas chog go /de tsam gyis 'chi med rnga sgra'i cho ga yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ba ri ba yan chad gong dang 'dra/ mchims brtson seng*/ rgya zhang phug pa/ 'jang pa shes rab rin chen/ e pa 'khon ston/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/ bla ma grags pa dpal bzang*/ bla ma chos 'phags rgyal 'tshan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge /bu ston chen po/ chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang*/ des bdag la'o/ /de ltar mchog tu ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i/ /tshe dang ye shes bla med sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rgyal ba'i bdag pos gsungs pa'i sngags rgyud lam/ /grub mchog stong gi shing rta'i rjes zhugs pa/ / lam 'dir 'jug pa dag kyang skal bzang ste/ /yid ches khungs ldan blo chen yid dga'i gnas/ / gzhan du las tshogs 'ga' zhig 'grub mthong yang*/
